summary_1line: Arjuna argues wealth and royal duty justify power and sacrifice; Yudhishthira rejects it, declaring he will renounce kingship for austere forest asceticism.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira declares his resolve to abandon the throne and wander the forest clothed in skins with matted hair.
An austere hermit Yudhishthira sits beneath a forest tree listening to birds while living on fruits and roots.
A wandering ascetic smeared with ashes walks alone without looking back, ignoring praise and blame.
